question: 76 times 2 - (33 + 15) + 58 - 49 + 27 = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/661340121ece4245dffae37dda41ddab0ce1f2bf0ba4a0210bff82185deedb2e.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using BODMAS: First solve the bracket and the multiplication.

76 × 2 = 152 and (33 + 15) = 48.

Expression: 152 − 48 + 58 − 49 + 27

Combine: (152 + 58 + 27) − (48 + 49) = 237 − 97 = 140.

**∴ The correct answer is 140.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84b0cc83321393e7b7c4fd18244706aacf48911fa9d4ad3bd90be5ab586bebe4.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: 76 × 2 − (33 + 15) + 58 − 49 + 27

Method: BODMAS (Brackets, Orders, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction)

⇒ 76 × 2 − 48 + 58 − 49 + 27

⇒ 152 − 48 + 58 − 49 + 27

⇒ 104 + 58 − 49 + 27

⇒ 162 − 49 + 27

⇒ 113 + 27

⇒ 140

**∴ The correct answer is 140.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

This rule dictates the order of operations in arithmetic: Brackets, Orders (powers/roots), Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.

Grouping Positive and Negative Terms

To minimize errors in long expressions, sum all positive numbers and all negative numbers separately before calculating the final difference.

Multiplication Priority

Multiplication and division must always be performed before addition and subtraction unless otherwise indicated by brackets.
